_why: STAGE 1 READ-ONLY ANALYSIS. `find_slot_output_alias` (operator.rs:1489) matches a HAVING aggregate call to an accumulator slot. For a COMPLEX argument (`CASE WHEN ...`) the HAVING side yields `arg_col = None`, and the slot side stores `value_column = None` for every complex arg, so the matcher's `(None, None) => true` arm (operator.rs:1530) matches the FIRST same-kind slot. With ONE such aggregate that is correct. With TWO same-kind complex args — `HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN side='BUY' THEN quantity END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN side='SELL' THEN quantity END) > 0` — both bind to the first Sum slot and the second silently reads the first's column. SILENT WRONG RESULT, not filter-everything: an earlier analysis in #1994 claimed the latter and was refuted by the #2021 pr-gate. This is #1749's thesis again — name resolution re-implemented at a site with a private matching rule weaker than the real one — and it is NOT a query-validation gap: the SQL is valid and accepted. The resolver that creates the `None` is plan/physical_dispatch_resolver/agg_args.rs (the issue's anchor for it is CORRECT). TWO REASONS THIS IS STAGE 1 AND NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION: (a) the issue states REACHABILITY IS UNVERIFIED — nobody has shown the wrong column reaches output, and it may be masked downstream; (b) the fix direction is explicitly NOT PINNED, and per .agents/rules/velo-brief-spec.md section 3 a genuine choice is an ORCHESTRATOR decision, never the worker's. Prove reachability, present options, STOP.

acceptance: match a HAVING aggregate call to its slot by INDEX-INSENSITIVE STRUCTURAL EQUALITY against AggSlot.agg_expr, comparing Column/ColumnRef CROSS-VARIANT (the HAVING copy is stamped ColumnRef{index,name} -> Column(name)) but NOT stripping qualifiers — `a.qty` and `b.qty` are different columns
the `(None, None) => true` arm survives ONLY for a COUNT-literal arg against a Count slot whose agg_expr is None
an aggregate call in HAVING that matches NO slot is a hard SqlError at PLAN TIME, in set_having_on_strategy, not a silent Null
the uncomparable-shape fallback is `_ => false` (loud no-match), never a permissive match
one statement of the rule: find_slot_output_alias delegates to the shared matcher rather than restating it
forbidden: do NOT reinstate qualifier-stripping in the leaf comparison
do NOT widen the fallback beyond `_ => false`
do NOT delete, skip or #[ignore] any test
do NOT fix the two flagged out-of-scope items here: the Utf8 vs Utf8View build_predicate error, and the projection-side analogue where two un-aliased same-kind complex aggregates both emit SUM(expr)
